calls.text: 3 Journeyman Wireman calls for Maddox Electric at Animal Kingdom. The hours are 5am to 1:30 pm, Monday through Friday with overtime opportunities. The scale is $32.64 an hour. Site orientation is on Monday’s for English and Tuesdays for Spanish.

6 Journeyman Wireman call for BVCC on dayshift for Shomari. They are working 5-10’s Monday through Friday with a 5am start time. The scale is $33.08 an hour. You will need scaffold safety, working at heights, and confined space certificates. You will also need to pass Disney’s background check.
